title: Othniel Delivers Israel
description: The Israelites did what was evil in the eyes of the Lord and worshiped Baal and Asherah. So the Lord gave them into the hands of Cushan-Rishathaim, king of Aram-Naharaim, for eight years. When they cried out to the Lord, he raised up Othniel, the son of Caleb's younger brother, as their deliverer. The spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he became a judge; he went out to war and won victory. The land had peace for forty years until Othniel died.
